alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued November 25 at 10:15PM CST until November 26 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 31 expected.

* WHERE...A portion of south central Texas.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 9 AM CST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
alerts.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

To prevent water pipes from freezing; wrap or drain or allow them to
drip slowly.

alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 26 at 5:34AM PST until November 26 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...The San Joaquin Valley.

* WHEN...For the first Dense Fog Advisory, until noon PST today. For
the second Dense Fog Advisory, from 8 PM this evening to noon PST
Friday.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways affected include, but are not limited
to, Interstate 5, and Highways 99, 198, 180, 41, 43, 46, 140, 152,
58, and 33.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
